info.name: V Tracker API v1
info.description: All 90 endpoints from the V Tracker technical documentation (PDF §6.4). Run AUTH-01 then AUTH-02 (or AUTH-03) first: tokens and ids are saved into collection variables automatically. Webhooks need X-Timestamp/X-Signature: get them from POST /v1/dev/webhooks/sign (development only).

request.description:
AUTH-01 - Create an owner account, attach an optional referrer and send a phone OTP. Repeating the call for an unverified phone updates the details and re-sends the OTP (rate-limited).

Auth: None
Called by: Signup tab

originalRequest.description:
AUTH-01 - Create an owner account, attach an optional referrer and send a phone OTP. Repeating the call for an unverified phone updates the details and re-sends the OTP (rate-limited).

Auth: None
Called by: Signup tab

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.verification) { pm.collectionVariables.set('challengeId', d.verification.challengeId); if (d.verification.devCode) pm.collectionVariables.set('otpCode', d.verification.devCode); }
